evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep jumps directly into details from the intake form ('I see all your details in here kings path...') with no time-box framing or promise of a dependable quote, and never asks for a yes before continuing.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep launches into pricing explanation and details gathering without asking 'what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep covers: 3 bedrooms (with bed counts), patio furniture, washer/dryer, no special fragile items, no heavy equipment, no additional stops. Property type (house) and stories/rooms largely covered through natural conversation.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Yes, asked early: 'Were you all needing us to come in and get everything boxed up for you all?' and discussed packing options.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: No box-count or overflow check offered.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provides range: '4 mover team...two trucks...I would estimate this job probably about six to seven hours...roughly $3,090' personalized to the mile-away distance allowing smaller team and two trips.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep discloses $105/hour per mover, $75 travel fee, explains time-based prorating (15-minute increments), mentions no credit card fees or material charges. Mentions rate-lock (no deposits, no cancellation fees) later, but the core 'not a guess' / 2.5-hour-minimum framing is absent.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked 'does that feel fair?' Rep moves directly to 'Do you have any questions about the pricing?'
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. No version of 'Does that put those to rest?' asked, and no two promises were even presented to close.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep never revisits concerns after estimate is given.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: No catch-all ('Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?') asked.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Rep never says 'Would you like our help with your move?' or equivalent. Conversation trails into logistics and email follow-up without a direct ask for the business.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Yes, mentioned in closing: 'we don't do deposits upfront and we don't do any cancellation or rescheduling fees.'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Rep confirms email (johngilbreth20@gmail.com), tentative date (October 24th with acknowledged uncertainty), and notes the customer's contingencies and communication channel, but never confirms arrival window, crew size, or address details explicitly on this call — relies entirely on email follow-up.

top_strength: Jack gathered comprehensive logistics details (bedrooms, appliances, outdoor furniture, special items, distance) through natural, conversational probing that felt collaborative rather than interrogative.
coaching_note: Jack never asked 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns?' at the start of Section 2, skipped the Two Promises entirely (On-Time and Damage Coverage), and never asked for the business explicitly — these are the three highest-leverage gaps in this call.
